identity_check: Confirmed as Seeq Corporation (seeq.com), the Seattle-datelined, fully virtual maker of advanced analytics and industrial AI software for process industries, launched by Steve Sliwa in May 2013 and now led by CEO Lisa Graham. All funding pages (Seeq's own releases for the Series B close, Series C and Series D; Global Venturing for earlier closes) describe the same company and the same investor base (Altira, Second Avenue Partners, Saudi Aramco Energy Ventures, Chevron Technology Ventures, Insight Partners). Category kept adjacent, layer plant_ops: Seeq's analytics and new Seeq Intelligence / Agent Q (a natural-language AI analyst over operational data) overlap Utopian's process-stability use case, but Seeq sells a self-service analytics platform to process engineers in large oil and gas, chemical, pharma and utility firms, with no procurement, RFQ / BOM or WhatsApp front-line agent.

layer_detail: Process analytics: self-service analytics, monitoring and AI agents (Seeq Intelligence, Agent Q) over industrial operational data
product_summary: Self-service analytics platform that lets process engineers and subject-matter experts investigate, monitor and report on operational data from existing plant systems. Seeq Intelligence adds Agent Q, a domain-aware natural-language AI analyst that assembles traceable investigations with recommended actions, and custom agents, for oil and gas, chemicals, pharma, mining and utilities.
